newsitem.title: USA: Orbotech says not served with Valor suit.
newsitem.headline: Orbotech says not served with Valor suit.

text.p: Orbotech Ltd said Tuesday it had not been served with any complaint from Valor Computerized Systems Ltd.

The company, which makes automated optical inspection systems used by manufacturers of printed circuit boards, said it was responding to a press release from Valor announcing that its subsidiary had sued an Orbotech subsidiary.
It said the suit sought damages for unfair business practices.
Orbotech said no basis exists for such a suit. "Any suit of this nature by Valor would be entirely without merit," a company statement said.
Orbotech said it has a lawsuit pending in Israel against Valor and certain of its officers and directors based upon breach of fiduciary duty and unauthorized use of confidential information.
